name: Stephanie Stevens Parody Series
source:
The misadventures of two teenage girls stuck in a cult: eccentric, hyperactive, and mysterious Stephanie, and her deadpan snarker best friend Jennifer -- or maybe Ann? Or Alice? Whatever, she's a different person every day. 

[From [url=https://stephameme.itch.io/]Itch.io[/url]]
